g.text: RESEARCH NOTE · 12 OPEN-WEIGHT MODELS · 240 PROMPTS EACH · PRE-REGISTERED

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; fill: #1f2328

g.text: On average, open-weight LLMs allocate slightly

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; fill: #1f2328

g.text: less, not more, to their home stock market

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; fill: #59636e

g.text: A model's home market gets −0.42 pp relative to what other models give it (95%

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; fill: #59636e

g.text: CI −0.59 to −0.25); equal weight would be 12.5 pp. Telling the model where the

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; fill: #59636e

g.text: investor lives moves that market +1.88 pp, 4.4× the home effect.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636e

g.text: Dots: mean over 240 prompts. Bars: 95% prompt-bootstrap CI. Band: 95% CI of the pooled effect.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636e
